name: docparse_extract_table
description: Extract table structure and cell evidence from a host-approved local document or parse result fixture using caller-provided specs.

user_message.description: Original user request or short task note used for table extraction context.

document_path.description: Workspace-local or host-approved document artifact reference to parse.

result_path.description: Workspace-local JSON result produced by document_parse or a host parser adapter.

parse_result.description: Inline parse result object when the caller already has parser output and wants projection without re-parsing.

spec_path.description: Workspace-local docparse spec directory or main.yaml path selected by caller or spec selection.

expected_tables.description: Expected table assertions such as table names, columns, rows, or required cells.

output_dir.description: Optional workspace-local artifact directory for parser outputs.

artifact_policy.description: Artifact retention hint such as summary, full, or none; host remains the policy owner.

page_limit.description: Maximum number of pages to parse or inspect for this request.

pdf_parse_mode.description: PDF extraction mode hint, for example default, simple, fast, normal, ocr, or force_ocr.
